checks.why: a method under an attribute derived from FactAttribute is a test xUnit runs, so what it reaches is credited to it, not to a sibling [Fact] through a fixture route (#1497)
the base is followed transitively: an attribute derived from the derived one is a test marker too
near miss: an attribute derived from Attribute alone does not make its method a test
control: a direct [Fact] is a test as before
